statements.status_notes: Debian security tracker lists trixie Redis 8.0.2 as unfixed with urgency unimportant. Redis GHSA-2r7g-8hpc-rpq9 states authenticated multi-bulk RESP use does not violate the Redis Security Model and no code fix is planned. An authenticated client can trigger the described memory consumption, so not_affected cannot be claimed; no Debian or upstream patch is available to backport.

Disputed and unreproducible upstream: NVD/CVE describe a segmentation fault in redis-server 5.0.7, but Redis maintainers could not reproduce it in a released 5.0.7 build (https://github.com/redis/redis/issues/6633). Debian security tracker lists trixie Redis 8.0.2 as unfixed with urgency unimportant and notes negligible security impact.
The Valkey hardening change comparing prev->used < prev->size in setDeferredReply is included in this package. See https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey/commit/374718b2a365ca69f715d542709b7d71540b1387.
